args.body: Hi Dora, I visited www.dora-website.com. The content I could access makes it clear that this is your personal website, and including your email makes it easy to contact you. I'd suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can find on the site, plus a few examples of your work or interests, to give it more personality. I could only review the text available to me, so I can't comment on the visual design.

Hi Eve, I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a promising theme. In the content I could access, I'd have liked to see more about you and some hiking posts—favorite trails, trip stories, or practical tips would give visitors a reason to return. I could only review the text available to me, so I can't comment on the visual design.

final_text:
Visited both websites, invited Dora to Slack using the email listed on her site, and sent both Dora and Eve direct messages with feedback.

- **Dora:** Suggested adding a personal introduction and examples of her work or interests.
- **Eve:** Suggested expanding on her hiking interest with trail recommendations, trip stories, or practical tips.

The feedback was based on the accessible text, not the sites’ visual design.
